rolecall.picker.title: RoleCall: pick your class
rolecall.picker.subtitle: Display-only F7/M7 role guide. A manual pick overrides Auto.
rolecall.picker.auto.tooltip: Reads your class from the tab list each run. Picking a class above overrides this until you choose Auto again.
rolecall.picker.predev.tooltip: Auto = on when the party has a Healer. Off hides Healer predev steps and sends Archer to the levers instead of waiting at Simon Says.
rolecall.picker.s4.tooltip: Berserk and Healer agree on this each run.
rolecall.editor.title: RoleCall HUD editor
rolecall.editor.help: Drag to move, scroll to scale (%sx), ESC to save
rolecall.cmd.class_auto: Class set to Auto (detect from tab list).
rolecall.cmd.class_unknown: Unknown class '%s'. Use archer, berserk, mage, healer, tank or auto.
rolecall.picker.crush.tooltip: Purple/Yellow (py): Tank crushes on purple, Mage on yellow. Green/Yellow (gy): Healer drops green, Tank drops yellow.
